inputs.invariant_points: n1_results/lethal_root/redo/points_3012000_300.jsonl.gz (300 games, 13,497 points, seeds 3012000-3012299, both seats r13d, 1 world x 1280 sims, budget 0, root_reply)

changes.candidate_1_trigger: attack upper bound counts only cards usable this turn (board + hand payable with active DON; hand/trash/deck widened by summon/cost-reduction/trash words) and only abilities live this turn (parsed Ability.raw_text; ON_PLAY only from hand, ON_ATTACK only on board or with rush, no opp-turn/counter/trigger/turn-start/turn-end). Bound = ready attackers + payable rush hand chars + double-attack cards. Same bound prunes own MAIN nodes in the tree.
changes.candidate_2_deal_order: already present (defensive deals first in make_deals); no change
changes.candidate_3_node_cap: curve only; not adopted (10k loses 71 of 1,175 proofs, 5k loses 160)
changes.candidate_4_speed: TT key: FxHasher instead of SipHash; Debug-string hashing of restrictions/replacements/battle/triggers/continuous/delayed/interaction stack replaced by derived Hash; plain cards hashed as 1 byte; variant dedupe by Value equality. Node counts bit-identical. Tried and reverted: TT on opponent nodes (-0.5% nodes, key cost larger).
changes.instrument: tests/scripts/lethal_speed_check.py (record / judge / compare); Game.lethal_json gains 'bound' diagnostics; prof categories lethal_*

command: python tests/scripts/lethal_speed_check.py record --games 300 --workers 3; ... judge --tag after; ... compare --a <audit points> --b judge_after.jsonl; taskset -c 0 python tests/scripts/rs_decide_latency.py --worlds 2 --lethal-proof root
notes: Trigger tightening (candidate 1) cut judged points by 18% (main 104% -> 85%) but barely reduced aborts: 80% of aborted points reach life+1 with ready attackers alone; most of the cost reduction came from candidate 4 (TT key hashing was 53% of per-node time).

unknown -> win at 25 of 13,497 points (and 1 of 20 latency games): smaller trees finish within 20,000 nodes; this changes the played move at those points in the direction of more proofs. Treated as allowed (spec forbids only win decreasing).
The baseline wheel replay reproduces the audit's 13,497 points bit-for-bit (status and nodes), so the audit's rs field is the 'before'.

Deck danger cards are still gated only by summon words (search text is not considered), same as before; trash is now gated by 'トラッシュ' text in usable cards' live abilities (before: trash always counted).
The invariant set contains 1 void game (seed 3012272, DON_BOX apply error at step 156, pre-existing in the audit redo); judge stops that game at the failing move.
Symmetric-card folding (identical copies in hand/field as one move) was analysed but not implemented; estimated further node reduction in aborted points, result-preserving. Left as next step.
Session container restarted once mid-run; the judge chain was relaunched from the saved record (results unaffected: judging is deterministic).
